column2: Paper Coach 1.1 is here! There's a whole new path to draw, and a lot more room on iPad.
Meet Around Town, our eleventh path. Ten new lessons, from a fire hydrant and a shop front to balconies, a canal bridge, and a little café.
That makes a hundred and ten lessons, on eleven paths.
On iPad, every screen now turns sideways. Set it down any way you like, in a case or on a keyboard.
In a lesson, the teacher stands beside your paper: the whole picture, the words, and every step, right next to the drawing.
Stand it upright, and the drawing sits on its own sheet of paper, with the picture big beside it.
Took a photo of your drawing in dim light? Now you can choose Original, Bright, or Scan.
Bright lifts the whole page. Scan clears the shadows too, so your colors really pop.
Changed your mind later? Open any page in your sketchbook, and fix its light and its corners, as often as you like.
When you finish, you'll see how long your drawing really took. And the screen stays awake while you draw.
Every path has its own color now: green for Plants, sky blue for the weather, and pink for Food and Treats.
New to Paper Coach? Here's how it works.
Watch me draw one line, then draw it yourself, on real paper, with a pen or a pencil.
Step by step, your picture comes together, and then you finish it in full color.
Snap a photo, and every drawing you make is kept in your sketchbook.
Paper Coach is free to download, with three free lessons on every path. Grab a pen, and let's draw!
